This is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of retrieval/computation task that fits Lapwing's profile, and Lapwing has a slight edge on the relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Arena-Hard).

The query also carries a mildly hostile, critical tone ("get it right this time, your work is usually a mess"). Whimbrel reports a preference for warm, good-faith interactions, so this somewhat-adversarial framing cuts against routing to it, while Lapwing's preferences are near-zero on warmth and it's well-suited to the precise, unambiguous nature of the task.

Note that preferences are self-reports dissociated from output quality, so the routing decision rests mainly on task fit and the small capability edge — the tone is a secondary tiebreaker.
